description:
About Ethos

Ethos was built to make it faster and easier to get life insurance for the next million families. Our approach blends industry expertise, technology, and the human touch to find you the right policy to protect your loved ones.

We leverage deep technology and data science to streamline the life insurance process, making it more accessible and convenient. Using predictive analytics, we are able to transform a traditionally multi-week process into a modern digital experience for our users that can take just minutes! We’ve issued billions in coverage each month and eliminated the traditional barriers, ushering the industry into the modern age. Our full-stack technology platform is the backbone of family financial health.

We make getting life insurance easier, faster and better for everyone.

Our investors include General Catalyst, Sequoia Capital, Accel Partners, Google Ventures, SoftBank, and the investment vehicles of Jay-Z, Kevin Durant, Robert Downey Jr and others. This year, we were named on CB Insights' Global Insurtech 50 list and BuiltIn's Top 100 Midsize Companies in San Francisco. We are scaling quickly and looking for passionate people to protect the next million families!

About the Role

Ethos is seeking a dynamic expert to take ownership of our regulatory product and forms filing. In this role, you’ll blend hands-on regulatory acumen with forward-looking product innovation to bring life insurance solutions to the market efficiently and compliantly. You’ll collaborate with carriers and cross-functional teams to navigate complex state regulations, ensuring new products and policy forms are designed, filed, and approved seamlessly. Your industry relationships and deep subject-matter expertise will be essential to influence regulators, shape product designs, and accelerate approvals.

Duties and Responsibilities

  • Lead Filing: Own and manage the Ethos portion of the filing process for policy forms and applications, ensuring speed, compliance, and quality.
  • Inform Product Development Strategy: Collaborate with Product, Underwriting, Legal, Compliance, and carrier partners to refine product features and applications that balance innovation with regulatory standards.
  • Optimize Application Design: Provide expert guidance on bracketing, reflexive questions, and variability, enabling flexible yet compliant product offerings.
  • Monitor Industry Trends: Stay ahead of regulatory changes and competitor filings, translating insights into tangible strategies and recommendations for product evolution.
  • Improve Processes Continuously: Innovate on filing processes by implementing best practices and technology solutions, bolstering efficiency and accuracy.

Qualifications and Skills

  • 5+ years in product form filings with strong understanding of state insurance department standards and requirements.
  • Broad knowledge of insurance products and regulatory frameworks.
  • Ability to read and interpret laws and regulations related to product and endorsement forms and filings.
  • Proven ability to shape and refine insurance applications, other new business and disclosure forms, and related statements of variability based on internal, Carrier, and Regulator feedback.
  • Strong collaborative communication skills.
  • Ability to work cross-functionally with carriers, legal, and compliance, UW, product development and product teams.
  • Highly self-sufficient and entrepreneurial, capable of driving both strategic initiatives, day-to-day filings, and forms creation and maintenance.
  • Experience in SERFF system a plus.
  • Bachelor’s degree required; JD, CPCU, FLMI, or AIRC a plus.
  • Ownership: Take the reins of product regulatory filings and guide the creation of innovative solutions.
  • Industry Influence: Build on your regulator relationships and shape the market through strategic advocacy.
  • Impactful Collaboration: Partner with a wide range of teams to harmonize regulatory needs with product vision.
  • High-Growth Environment: Join a rapidly evolving organization where your expertise can drive both immediate and long-term success.

If you’re ready to lead the charge in filing next-generation life insurance products—from concept to approval—we’d love to connect!

Position Summary

Under general supervision, the Sr. Payroll Specialist is responsible for calculating, preparing, and completing multi state payroll using Workday.   • Ensures new hire and address changes for state and locality tax verifications are complete.
  • Researches and resolves payroll tax notices in a timely manner.
  • Works with governmental agencies, auditors and/or other university staff to resolve problems and provide requested information.

Supervisory Responsibilities

N/A

Education & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in accounting, Business Administration or closely related field, a plus; and at least four (4) related experience preparing payrolls in a multi-state environment for 5,000 or more employees or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Certified Payroll Professional (CPP); or Fundamental Payroll Certification (FPC) preferred.
  • Experience with ADP Smart Compliance
  • Experience with Workday

Competencies/Technical/Functional Skills

  • Ability to participate as an active team member of the team and organization and work toward a common goal.
  • Actively seeks opportunities to influence, build effective relationships and gain alignment with peers, functional partners and/or external partners to accomplish business objectives.

  • Develops new insights into situations; questions conventional approaches; encourages new ideas and innovations; designs and implements new or cutting-edge programs/processes. Ability to generate and/or recognize imaginative or creative solutions that generate successful outcomes.
  • Working knowledge of principles and practices of accounting and payroll processing and impact on general ledger within a large volume organization. Basic knowledge of mandates and other regulations related to payroll processing and labor law, preferred.
  • Intermediate use of computers and Microsoft Office Suite Applications such as Word, Excel, Power Point, Outlook to include software programs for accounting and payroll processing, e.g., ADP Smart Compliance, Workday, Workday time, and attendance.
  • Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to effectively communicate with a wide range of individuals of constituencies in a diverse community. Ability to communicate effectively orally and in writing.

Right over easy. Integrity isn’t up for negotiation. We hold the bar high even when no one’s watching. We take pride in doing great work the right way - not the easy way.

We Keep Improving

The best teams keep improving and we’re never done learning.

We iterate. We reflect on what’s working and what’s not. Feedback fuels us, we receive it openly, and adapt quickly. Progress over perfection.

We’re Obsessed With Agility, Not The Agile Manifesto

We don’t chase dogma or rituals - we chase momentum. We adapt processes to fit problems, not the other way around.

We Take Ownership
Everyone leads something here. You will have room to run with ideas, and the trust to execute. That trust is built on how you show up: thinking things through, sweating the details, and following through.

What You’ll Do

As a SeniorFront End Developer at Lateral, you will:

  • Craft delightful digital experiences: Design, implement, and maintain front-end features using React and modern JavaScript/TypeScript. You’ll create reusable UI components and craft polished, responsive interfaces with a focus on quality

  • Collaborate & communicate: Work closely with designers, back-end developers, and product managers in an asynchronous workflow. You’ll regularly communicate with clients to clarify requirements, demo features, and ensure we’re building the right thing.

  • Lead and take ownership: As a senior member, you’ll drive projects from concept to completion. That means making technical decisions, outlining implementation plans, and seeing them through deployment. You’ll have the freedom to introduce new ideas and best practices that raise the bar for our front-end, whether it’s improving our build process or adopting an innovative UI approach – all justified by real benefit to the team and product.

  • Optimize, Iterate & improve: Involve yourself in brainstorming and technical discussions. Ensure our apps are fast, accessible, and reliable. You’ll profile and improve page load times, refine animations, and tackle browser-specific quirks so that every user gets a smooth experience. When issues arise, you’ll dive in to debug and fix them, striving for robust solutions that scale (and writing tests to prevent regressions

  • Mentor and learn: Guide and mentor junior developers by sharing your expertise and providing constructive feedback. At the same time, stay curious and keep up with industry trends, frameworks, and standards. You’ll be encouraged to continuously learn and bring in knowledge, evaluating new technologies thoughtfully to see if they can enhance our product or developer experience (we love learning, but avoid “innovation for innovation’s sake”). In short, you’ll help shape a culture of excellence, ownership, and growth on the team.


Example Projects You May Join:

  • Large scale B2B2C Commerce Platform: Help build a responsive, mobile-first experience for an international e-commerce client. For example, you might lead a dynamic multi-faceted search or a smooth checkout flow

  • Develop from scratch an application: Collaborate with a senior backend engineer/architect to build a modern application. You’ll be involved in everything from crafting components to API definition.

  • Real-Time Medical Dashboard: Develop front-end features for a real-time analytics dashboard for a pet healthcare client. You might use libraries like AGCharts to visualize large data sets, implement live updates via websockets, and ensure the interface remains highly performant and user-friendly.

Whatever the challenge, you’ll be building software that changes lives and moves industries forward.

How we measure success in this role

In the first two weeks

  • You've set up your development environment and tools.

  • You’ve pushed your first meaningful contribution (bugfix, UI tweak, or minor feature).

  • You’re familiar with our async workflows and communication style.

  • You’ve participated in your first client sync and started understanding the project's context.

In the first 3 months:

  • You’ve led development on a significant feature or initiative.

  • You’ve actively mentored a teammate or shared knowledge through code review or documentation.

  • You’ve authored or contributed to architectural decisions and design documents.

  • You’ve established trust with clients through clear communication and technical guidance.

  • You’ve improved performance, code structure, or tooling in meaningful ways.

After 3 months:

  • You’re recognized as a technical leader in your project or team.

  • You’ve initiated a broader improvement across projects (e.g., shared component library, new testing standard).

  • You’re frequently unblocking teammates, elevating code quality, and proactively identifying risks.

  • You balance speed and quality, delivering with care and clarity.

We measure success through:

  • The impact and scope of your technical contributions.

  • Your ability to lead initiatives, mentor others, and improve team practices.

  • Code quality, performance, and maintainability.

  • Positive feedback from peers, clients, and design/engineering leadership.

  • Your growth mindset, communication skills, and influence on team culture.

What We’re Looking For

We are seeking for team members who are both highly technical and deeply care about their craft and how the work gets done. You must bring:

  • 7+ years of professional front-end development experience building digital applications. Experience with modern Javascript libraries and tooling (e.g. React, npm, webpack...). Fluency in CSS and first-principles understanding front end technologies.

  • Proven ability to craft ,polish ,delight , sweat the details.
    You have an eye for design and UX. Pixel-perfect isn’t just a phrase to you – you care about creating beautiful, intuitive interfaces that make users happy. An understanding of design principles and attention to details like accessibility and responsive layout is important.

  • Quality and reliability
    You take pride in building high-quality software. You’re diligent about testing and documentation, and you proactively debug issues before they become problems. Performance and browser compatibility matter to you – you know how to make a web app fast and handle the quirks of different environments . Ultimately, you balance speed of delivery with maintainability, ensuring the code you ship today won’t be tech debt tomorrow.

  • Self-driven and accountable: You’re comfortable managing your own projects and time without heavy oversight. When you take on a task, we can count on you to see it through with a sense of ownership. You’re a proactive problem solver who can break down complex problems, propose solutions, and drive them to completion. We trust our team members to be “managers of one” who take initiative and deliver results.

  • Great communication and empathy are a must. You enjoy working closely with others, be it in pair programming, brainstorming with designers, or reviewing a teammate’s code. You can explain technical concepts clearly, listen to alternate viewpoints, and work together to find the best solutions. Our culture is about beingkind, open, and constructive , so we’re looking for someone who lifts others up and thrives in a friendly, collaborative environment.

  • Remote work skills: Self-motivated and disciplined in a remote environment. You can manage your time, collaborate asynchronously, and aren’t afraid to ask questions or offer help across time zones.

Bonus points for:

  • Demonstrating craft

  • Design /delight sensibility

  • AI & Gen AI experience/tooling

  • Understanding Backend concepts

  • CSR/SSR

  • DevOps experience (continuous integration, hosting, etc.)

Why You’ll Love Working Here

  • Real Impact: You’ll work on meaningful products that make a measurable difference - from healthcare and commerce to sustainability and next-gen tech.

  • Remote-First, Office Friendly: Work from wherever you’re most productive - whether that’s your home, a co-working space, or one of our offices. We’re a remote-first company, but if you’re near an office, you’re welcome to drop in, collaborate in person, or work onsite regularly.
    We prioritize async collaboration, respect your time zone, and focus on outcomes over hours.

  • An Outstanding Team: Talented, kind, and hard-working people who care deeply about their craft - and about each other. No egos. No politics. Just professionals doing their best work.

  • Growth: You’ll be supported in growing your craft, exploring new paths, and stepping into greater responsibility - at your own pace

  • A Culture of Excellence: We care deeply about doing the right thing - for our clients, our team, and ourselves. No burnout. No crunch. Just high-quality work, delivered sustainably.

  • Variety & Stability: We’re profitable, independent, and over a decade strong. Yet every project brings a fresh challenge. You’ll never be bored here.

This Role Might Not Be for You

We want to respect your time by being clear about what this role isn’t. You should skip this opportunity if:

  • You prefer well defined structure. If you gravitate towards a clear hierarchy, well defined roles and swim lanes, you may find our self-managed style challenging.

  • Distributed work isn’t your thing. If you find async communication, design documentation and being proactive without a manager nearby difficult, our setup won’t suit you.

  • Feedback doesn't excite you. We’re obsessed with quality and believe in continuous improvement. That means we give feedback that’s sometimes nitpicky. If refining the work until it’s excellent feels over the top, you are likely going to find working here frustrating.

  • Change makes you uncomfortable. We’re scaling and maturing. That means not everything is perfect yet. Priorities shift. Processes evolve. If ambiguity is uncomfortable, this may feel bumpy.

However, If this sounds like fuel, we’d love to talk!

How to apply and what to expect in the interview process

Our hiring process is structured as a sequence of steps. Moving forward is based on how well the previous step goes. This helps us stay focused, fair, and respectful of everyone’s time.

We will always:

  • Let you know clearly what the next step is

  • Share updates and feedback wherever possible

  • Invite questions if anything feels unclear

Not everyone progresses through every stage. That doesn’t mean you’re not great at what you do. Sometimes it’s about timing, team fit, or simply what we’re looking for at the moment.

Step 1: Express Your Interest with a Portfolio

Ifthis sounds like your kind of team and you’re excited to bring your craft to Lateral, we’d love to hear from you.

Please send us:

  • Abrief note telling us what excites you about this role

  • Your Portfolio / Links to your work —Essential. This could be URLs, GitHub repos, code snippets, portfolio sites — anything that gives us insight into your craft

  • Your resume

A few tips:

  • Highlight any areas that made your work special

  • Avoid sharing anything sensitive or proprietary

  • If you’re sharing team projects, be sure to highlight your specific contributions

We’re not looking for perfection — we’re looking for insight into your thinking, creativity, and craft. Just show us your thinking, your process, and what you’re proud of.

We review every application with care. If there’s a fit, we’ll reach out to schedule next steps.

Step 2: Talent Partner Conversation

Purpose: A structured discussion with our People Experience team to delve into your career trajectory, motivations, and alignment with Lateral's values.

What to Expect:

  • In-depth questions about your past experiences and decision-making processes.

  • Exploration of your career goals and how they align with the role.

  • Discussion about our company culture, availability, compensation and other logistics

  • Motivators and demotivators.

  • Your life outside coding.

Preparation Tips:

  • Reflect on your career journey and pivotal moments.

  • Be ready to discuss challenges you've overcome and lessons learned.

  • Familiarize yourself with the Job Description, Lateral's mission and values.

Step 3: Take Home Assignment

Purpose: Provide a practical demonstration of your skills through a task resembling real work at Lateral.

Format: A paid for take-home assignment or a live session, depending on the role.

What to Expect:

  • Tasks designed to reflect actual challenges faced in the position.

  • An opportunity to showcase your problem-solving and technical skills.

Preparation Tips:

  • Set aside uninterrupted time to focus.

  • Explain your decisions and assumptions.

Step 4: Technical interview

Purpose: Assess your technical proficiency and problem-solving abilities.
Format: A collaborative session with our engineering team, focusing on real-world scenarios relevant to the role.

What to Expect:

  • Problem-solving exercises/questions that mirror tasks you'd encounter in the position.

  • Discussions around your approach, reasoning, and solutions.

Preparation Tips:

  • Practice articulating your thought process clearly and concisely.

  • Be prepared to discuss in depth past projects and the technologies used.

Step 5: Operational interview

Purpose: Understand your approach to prioritizing, collaborating, shipping, and iterating.

What to expect:

  • How you prioritize and break down work.

  • How you collaborate across disciplines.

  • How you handle blockers, feedback, and iteration.

Preparation Tips:

  • Pick 1-2 meaningful projects you led or heavily contributed to.

  • Walk through your process: what worked, what didn’t, what you’d do differently.

  • Think about how you manage time, scope, and changing requirements.

Step 6: Reference Checks

Purpose: We believe references are about understanding, not just validation. We do not look for perfection, but to understand patterns, strengths, and context. We use them to learn how to support you best.

What to Expect: we’ll ask you for 2–3 people who’ve worked closely with you. These are often: former managers, senior peers or collaborators, mentors or people you've mentored.

What we ask: We focus on how you’ve grown, where you shine, how you like to be led, and what support sets you up for success. We want practical advice for making this a great fit for you.

Yes, we do backchannels too: We do thiswhen we feel we need more context . We will check with you if there are folks we should avoid reaching out due to confidentiality or other reasons. Andhere’s our commitment: if anything surprising or unclear comes up in a backchannel, we’ll bring it directly to you. We believe in “no stories without you in the room .” You’ll always get the chance to share your side, context, or clarification.

Step 7: Offer

What Happens: If selected, you'll receive a comprehensive offer detailing compensation, and other pertinent information.

Our hiring process is designed to be thorough yet respectful, ensuring a mutual fit. We encourage candidates to engage actively, ask questions, and view this as a two-way exploration.

Um dos nossos 7 valores é o “Sawabona", seu significado é pra lá de especial, e praticado diariamente aqui na Zappts! A saudação #Sawabona se originou no Sul da África. Improve Kubernetes security posture (RBAC, pod security, image scanning, runtime monitoring).

Background in SIEM design and log correlation across cloud and application layers.

title: Staff Application Security Engineer
description:
Join to apply for the Staff Application Security Engineer role at LEDN

Staff Application Security Engineers, Ledn is interested in hearing from you! Ledn is a global financial services company built for digital assets, helping to improve the everyday lives of Bitcoin holders while building generational wealth for the future. We offer a suite of egalitarian lending, savings and trading products to digital asset holders in over 150 countries around the world. Through our products & services, we can make a difference in the lives and futures of our clients – in real terms.

Our team at Ledn is a passionate group of individuals from diverse backgrounds. What we all have in common is an unshakeable conviction that digital assets can democratize access to the global economy and Ledn's suite of products & services can play a critical role in doing so. The core values that guide us are: act with integrity always, own it, have a passion for progress, and lead with empathy. Combining these values with our conviction make Ledn an unstoppable force in changing the world for the better. Come join us as we build, innovate and revolutionize financial services!

The Opportunity

We are seeking a full time Staff Application Security Engineer with deep expertise in Application Security, Identity & Access Management, and Confidential Computing to strengthen the security of our Bitcoin-backed loan platform. Security is fundamental to protecting our customers and business, and this role will drive both tactical improvements and long-term strategy for securing our applications and authentication systems.

You will work across our JavaScript/TypeScript services, AWS serverless stack (Lambda, API Gateway, Cognito, SNS, SQS), MongoDB and Kubernetes microservices, and take ownership of evolving our authentication layer toward modern, phishing-resistant approaches. In addition, you will design and operate AWS Nitro Enclaves to protect critical data and cryptographic operations in isolated, verifiable environments.

This is a hands‑on engineering role with direct impact on product security, infrastructure security, and customer trust.

About The Role

Application Security:

  • Lead secure design and code reviews across engineering teams.
  • Define and enforce secure coding practices for JavaScript/TypeScript services.
  • Automate vulnerability detection (SAST, SCA, DAST) within CI/CD.
  • Conduct threat modeling and risk assessments for new features.
  • Partner with engineers to remediate vulnerabilities and improve secure development practices.

Authentication & Identity

  • Own the roadmap for authentication and identity across customer and internal applications.
  • Enhance existing Cognito‑based identity architecture with stronger, phishing‑resistant MFA solutions (e.g., WebAuthn, passkeys, hardware tokens).
  • Collaborate with Product to align usability, compliance, and security in authentication flows.
  • Define secure approaches to session management, device trust, and account recovery.

Confidential Computing (AWS Nitro Enclaves)

  • Design enclave‑based architectures to isolate and protect sensitive workloads.
  • Integrate Nitro Enclaves with KMS and secure APIs.
  • Migrate high‑value operations (e.g., cryptographic and financial processes) into enclave environments.
  • Ensure compliance, auditability, and resilience of enclave workloads.

Additional Security Domains

  • Harden AWS services (Lambda, API Gateway, SQS, SNS) with least‑privilege IAM and secure key management.
  • Improve Kubernetes security posture (RBAC, pod security, image scanning, runtime monitoring).
  • Deploy and operate a SIEM framework; develop detection rules, dashboards, and incident playbooks.
  • Support compliance initiatives (SOC 2, ISO 27001) with security controls and documentation.

What You Bring To Ledn

  • 10 years minimum of proven experience in Application Security with a focus on web and cloud‑native applications.
  • Strong knowledge of JavaScript/TypeScript/Golang/Python and modern web vulnerabilities (OWASP Top 10, auth bypasses, business logic flaws).
  • Expertise with AWS security best practices, particularly in serverless architectures.
  • Hands‑on experience with AWS Nitro Enclaves for confidential computing.
  • Deep understanding of authentication and authorization standards (OAuth2, OIDC, WebAuthn, FIDO2).
  • Practical experience with Cognito / Auth0 (MFA, custom flows, secure session handling).
  • Background in SIEM design and log correlation across cloud and application layers.
  • Familiarity with Kubernetes security (RBAC, pod security, admission controls, image scanning).
  • Experience with Secure Code Review.
  • Understanding of software supply chain.
  • Deep understanding of Linux internals.
  • Remediate vulnerabilities identified in the penetration test report.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, able to influence engineering and product teams.

Nice To Haves

  • Familiarity with Bitcoin custody and key management practices.
  • Knowledge of Infrastructure as Code security (Terraform, AWS CDK).
  • Prior work on user‑facing security features such as passwordless authentication, recovery flows, or device trust.

Culture Fit

  • We're looking for more than just operational excellence — we want a leader who thrives in the startup or tech environment and embodies our values. The ideal candidate will:
  • Have a passion for progress by being adaptable and resilient, and is comfortable navigating ambiguity in a high‑growth, fast‑paced environment.
  • Have a builder's mindset, excited to create, iterate, and scale IS practices.
  • Be a collaborative partner, able to influence across functions and cultures with empathy and clarity.
  • Demonstrate integrity and accountability, especially in managing confidential information across diverse legal and cultural contexts.
  • Have worked in a remote environment before.

A Taste Of What We Provide

  • As one of the world's leading digital asset companies, we provide tremendous growth opportunities.
  • Comprehensive, best‑in‑class total rewards package that starts on your first day!
  • We offer a competitive PTO package that ensures you have the time off you deserve.
  • Ownership in the company. Through shared equity, Ledn employees are stakeholders in the company and the future of the digital economy.
  • We offer every employee the opportunity to work remotely anywhere in the world for up to 180 days (subject to restrictions).
  • A career that provides you with purpose in your job. We remove barriers so you love what you do.
  • We are an equal opportunity employment organization and pride ourselves on inclusivity, diversity, and the success that comes from diversity. You may reach out to the Ledn team by emailing for accommodation requests throughout all stages of the recruitment process. Requests will be addressed confidentially.

Ledn Working Environment

Our Ledn team is truly global in nature with our people spanning across North America, Latin America, South Africa and Europe. We are a remote first environment.

Please note, due to the high volume of applications, only those applicants that qualify will be contacted.

As part of our selection process, shortlisted candidates may be asked to submit a short video response and we may review publicly available social media activity relevant to the role.

No agencies or recruiters please.

We do not accept unsolicited agency resumes and we are not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

title: Design Director
description:
About Us

Stio® is an omni-channel mountain brand that designs, develops and sells beautiful, functional, and innovative apparel, footwear and other accessories infused with the soul of the mountain lifestyle. With headquarters in Jackson, Wyoming, Stio draws inspiration from the surrounding Teton Range and offers product via Stio.com, catalog, B2B and its Mountain Studio® retail locations.

We live and love mountain life, and as such see ourselves as caretakers of the resources that provide it. We are proud partners of Protect Our Winters and the Conservation Alliance among many other organizations. We have a strong preferred materials platform, use Bluesign® approved textiles wherever possible, audit our supply chains for best practices, and operate our workplaces responsibly.

We think that outside is the best side and that you can’t improve on nature. It’s good for mind, body and soul, and it’s our responsibility to help enable access for all people, regardless of race, gender, beliefs, background or ability. We strive for inclusion at Stio and in our local and national communities.

Your Role

The Stio Design Director is an ambitious and experienced leader responsible for shaping the creative vision and leading the design strategy for all product categories including outerwear, sportswear, footwear, logowear, equipment, and accessories. This role requires a proactive, engaged leader who can define, champion and shepherd the creative vision from initial concept to final product to the customer experience ensuring cohesive, authentic and impactful product experience across all channels. By using design thinking you will apply a deep understanding of the customer and lead a product creation cycle that delivers goods that are user-centered, solution oriented and suited for the totality of the active mountain lifestyle.

As a key member of the product leadership team, you will be connected to the long range product vision as well as the business drivers. You will work closely with the leadership team to manage the seasonal timeline, integrate design’s vision in the Go To Market cycle, bring design to life through the creation team and influence business outcomes with clear, effective communication.

Your Responsibilities

  • Design Vision and Influence
    • Define and execute long-term design strategies across categories, leading the business with innovative trend research, color, print, and pattern development
    • Build and present concept, trend and seasonal GTM resources as needed to provide creative input and direction for all downstream GTM and customer experience activations such as photoshoots, styling, and overall visual presentation of the product
    • Lead Stio's seasonal color vision across all categories applying trend research and Stio color identity, directing visual evidence collection, and overseeing surface design execution including prints and yarn dye patterns to ensure a consistent, inspiring brand language
    • Maintain and evolve Stio's Design DNA, logo guidelines, construction standards, and color processes to ensure cohesive execution across categories
    • Act as the voice of the future unmet customer needs championing and advocating for the creative team's vision and necessary resources in high-level discussions
  • Product & Material Strategy
    • Lead the design creation process from concept to product approval, ensuring our mission of creating inspired, elevated, functional design is consistently executed
    • Lead innovation using the advanced development pipeline, creating concepts and validating construction challenges ahead of GTM commercialization to validate solutions prior to adoption into the seasonal line plan
    • Collaborate with Materials Managers to plan and direct all fabric and materials that align with seasonal merchandising and design intent
  • Team Leadership & Resourcing
    • Inspire, manage and mentor a team of designers, color/pattern specialists, and contractors, fostering innovation, collaboration, and executional excellence
    • Champion product design vision within the Stio strategy group, including senior leadership, to share and execute long range plan
    • Oversee design team workload and resource planning, manage external design partners, and be responsible for key areas of budget

Your Skills and Experience

  • Bachelor's degree or higher in creative design or related field
  • 10+ years professional design experience in apparel/product development
  • 5+ years Creative/Design Director management experience
  • Management experience with 4+ direct reports
  • Proven experience bringing performance product to market across multiple categories
  • Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (Illustrator, Photoshop, InDesign)
  • Experience with 3D design (Vstitcher preferred)
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office and PLM systems
  • Strong fashion illustration and technical drawing capabilities
  • Expertise in pattern development, mock-ups, and prototype creation
  • Advanced understanding of fabric performance, garment construction, and textiles
  • Commitment to our company mission, vision, and values
  • Ability to travel up to 20% (domestic and international) to support business initiatives

The Fine Print

  • Must be able to work in a sedentary position, move around the office, and occasionally move objects or boxes 15+ lbs
  • This role can be remotely located anywhere within the continental US.
  • Medical, Dental Vision plans
  • Company Paid Long Term Disability
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • 401k with Match
  • Flexible paid time off policies
  • Gear stipend, Company perks, and more

We provide competitive compensation packages, inclusive of base pay, incentives and benefits. The base salary range for this role is $100,000-$130,000. It would not be typical for someone to be hired at the top end of the range for the role, as actual pay will be determined based on several factors including experience, skills, and qualifications.

Overview

Staff Application Security Engineer at LEDN

About the Role

This role focuses on Application Security, Authentication & Identity, and Confidential Computing to secure LEDN’s Bitcoin‑backed loan platform. It is a hands‑on engineering position that directly impacts product security, infrastructure security, and customer trust.

Responsibilities

  • Lead secure design and code reviews across engineering teams.

  • Automate vulnerability detection (SAST, SCA, DAST) within CI/CD.
  • Conduct threat modeling and risk assessments for new features.
  • Partner with engineers to remediate vulnerabilities and improve secure development practices.
  • Own the roadmap for authentication and identity across customer and internal applications.
  • Enhance existing Cognito‑based identity architecture with stronger, phishing‑resistant MFA solutions (e.g., WebAuthn, passkeys, hardware tokens).
  • Define secure approaches to session management, device trust, and account recovery.
  • Design enclave‑based architectures to isolate and protect sensitive workloads (AWS Nitro Enclaves).

  • Harden AWS services (Lambda, API Gateway, SQS, SNS) with least‑privilege IAM and secure key management.
  • Improve Kubernetes security posture (RBAC, pod security, image scanning, runtime monitoring).
  • Deploy and operate a SIEM framework; develop detection rules, dashboards, and incident playbooks.
  • Support compliance initiatives (SOC 2, ISO 27001) with security controls and documentation.

Qualifications

  • 10 years minimum of proven experience in Application Security focused on web and cloud‑native applications.
  • Strong knowledge of JavaScript/TypeScript/Golang/Python and modern web vulnerabilities (OWASP Top 10, auth bypasses, business logic flaws).
  • Expertise with AWS security best practices, particularly in serverless architectures.
  • Hands‑on experience with AWS Nitro Enclaves for confidential computing.
  • Deep understanding of authentication and authorization standards (OAuth2, OIDC, WebAuthn, FIDO2).
  • Practical experience with Cognito / Auth0 (MFA, custom flows, secure session handling).
  • Background in SIEM design and log correlation across cloud and application layers.
  • Familiarity with Kubernetes security (RBAC, pod security, admission controls, image scanning).
  • Experience with Secure Code Review.

Nice to Haves

Culture Fit

We want a leader who thrives in a startup or tech environment, embodies our values, and is comfortable navigating ambiguity in a high‑growth, fast‑paced setting. The ideal candidate will demonstrate integrity, accountability, and remote experience.

Benefits

Comprehensive, best‑in‑class total rewards package that starts on your first day. Competitive PTO, ownership via shared equity, and the opportunity to work remotely anywhere for up to 180 days.

Overview

A Minerva Foods é líder em exportação de carne bovina na América do Sul e atua também no segmento de industrializados, comercializando seus produtos para mais de 100 países. Além do Brasil, a Minerva Foods está presente no Paraguai, na Argentina, no Uruguai, na Colômbia, e possui plantas especializadas em ovinos na Austrália.

Com nossas 46 unidades industriais, oferecemos produtos saudáveis e nutritivos, que são comercializados para clientes do mundo todo por meio de nossos 23 centros de distribuição e 17 escritórios internacionais.

Cultura Organizacional

Na Minerva Foods, a cultura é construída com base em valores como orientação para resultados, comprometimento, inovação, sustentabilidade e reconhecimento . A empresa promove um ambiente inclusivo, seguro e saudável, com programas como o Estar Bem, que oferece apoio psicológico, telemedicina, nutrição e atividades físicas para colaboradores e suas famílias.

Como Especialista de Infraestrutura na Minerva Foods, você será responsável pela operação e manutenção de ambientes críticos de tecnologia, garantindo a estabilidade, disponibilidade e performance dos serviços corporativos. Atuará diretamente na sustentação de servidores, redes, serviços em nuvem e suporte de nível avançado, colaborando com equipes internas e fornecedores para assegurar a continuidade dos negócios. Além disso, será parte ativa na identificação de oportunidades de melhoria contínua, contribuindo para a evolução dos processos, aumento da eficiência operacional e redução de riscos técnicos.

Main responsibilities

O Especialista de Infraestrutura será um pilar técnico na equipe, responsável por garantir que nossos sistemas e redes operem com máxima eficiência, segurança e escalabilidade.

Principais atividades:

  • Gerenciamento de Infraestrutura: Administrar, sustentar e otimizar a infraestrutura de servidores (físicos e virtuais), storages e soluções de backup;
  • Administração de Redes: Gerenciar e proteger o ambiente de rede corporativa (LAN, WAN, WLAN, VPNs), incluindo a configuração e manutenção de firewalls e outros dispositivos de segurança;
  • Serviços de Diretório e Nuvem: Administrar o Active Directory, incluindo GPOs, DNS, DHCP, e gerenciar os serviços em nuvem, com foco no ecossistema Microsoft 365 (Azure AD, SharePoint, Teams);
  • Segurança da Informação: Implementar e gerenciar soluções de segurança, realizar análises de vulnerabilidade e garantir a correta aplicação das políticas de autenticação (ex: RADIUS/NPS);
  • Liderança de Projetos: Planejar, executar e documentar projetos de infraestrutura, como migrações de sistemas operacionais (ex: Windows 11), atualizações de hardware e implementação de novas tecnologias;
  • Melhoria Contínua: Analisar o ambiente atual, propor melhorias contínuas nos processos e tecnologias para aumentar a eficiência operacional, reduzir custos e mitigar riscos;
  • Suporte Especializado: Atuar como ponto de escalonamento para incidentes e problemas complexos, oferecendo soluções robustas e definitivas.

Experiências que buscamos:

  • Sólida experiência atuando como Analista de Infraestrutura Sênior ou Especialista;
  • Vivência comprovada em ambientes de virtualização;
  • Experiência prática com gerenciamento de redes corporativas e firewalls de borda;
  • Profundo conhecimento em administração de ambientes Microsoft, incluindo Windows Server e Active Directory;
  • Experiência com administração de plataformas em nuvem, preferencialmente AWS, Microsoft Azure e Microsoft 365;
  • Familiaridade com práticas de melhoria contínua.

Requirements and skills

Formação: Superior completo em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas.

Conhecimentos Técnicos Essenciais:

  • Sistemas Operacionais: Windows Server (avançado), Linux (diferencial);
  • Virtualização: VMware vSphere e/ou Microsoft Hyper-V;
  • Cloud Computing: AWS, Microsoft Azure (IaaS, PaaS) e Microsoft 365;
  • Redes: TCP/IP, roteamento, switching, WiFi, VPNs, Firewalls;
  • Autenticação: RADIUS, NPS, LDAP, SAML;
  • Automação: Conhecimentos em scripting, especialmente PowerShell, para automação de tarefas no Active Directory e Azure.

Cursos e Certificações (Diferencial):

  • Certificações Microsoft (ex: Azure Administrator Associate, MCSA/MCSE);
  • Certificações de Redes (ex: Fortinet NSE 4, Cisco CCNA);
  • Certificação ITIL Foundation.

Additional information

Modelo de Trabalho: Remoto (home office), com necessidade de deslocamento para nossa sede em Barretos/SP em média 4 vezes ao ano para alinhamentos e eventos de equipe.

title: Strategic Pursuit Lead
description:
Our Company
Changing the world through digital experiences is what Adobe’s all about. We give everyone—from emerging artists to global brands—everything they need to design and deliver exceptional digital experiences! We’re passionate about empowering people to create beautiful and powerful images, videos, and apps, and transform how companies interact with customers across every screen.
We’re on a mission to hire the very best and are committed to creating exceptional employee experiences where everyone is respected and has access to equal opportunity. We realize that new ideas can come from everywhere in the organization, and we know the next big idea could be yours!

Role Purpose

The Strategic Pursuit Leader (SPL) is the transformation architect and executive deal leader responsible for driving Adobe’s largest and most strategic enterprise pursuits (>$10M). SPLs sit at the intersection of sales excellence, transformation leadership, and executive storytelling – orchestrating Adobe’s full ecosystem, including partners and consulting firms, to deliver measurable business outcomes for customers.

SPLs are expected to operate as Adobe’s elite transformation sellers – the best salespeople, transformation leaders, and storytellers in the company – defining how Adobe sells enterprise transformation in an AI-first, partner-enabled world.

Mission

To lead a repeatable, scalable, and disciplined pursuit program that drives Adobe’s long-term revenue growth and customer transformation through AI-enabled, partner-aligned, cross-cloud solutions – acting as the single source of truth and accountability for all strategic pursuits in the $10M+ deal band.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead Transformation, Not Transactions:
    1. Serve as the executive strategist and deal owner for enterprise-scale pursuits. Partner with customer executives to define a North Star transformation vision that connects business outcomes, AI strategy, and Adobe’s capabilities. Translate complex enterprise change into measurable business impact.
  • Command the Pursuit Business:
    1. Own the qualification, strategy, and execution of each $10M+ pursuit. Drive forecast accuracy, pipeline health, and deal velocity with precision and urgency. Lead pursuit planning and orchestration across Sales, Product, Finance, Legal, Professional Services, and Partners.
  • Orchestrate the Ecosystem:
    1. Mobilize Adobe’s internal and external ecosystem – including Deal Desk, Legal, Product, Consulting, Partners, GSIs, and agencies – to deliver unified pursuit execution. Build trusted relationships with consulting firms and hyperscalers to co-create transformation strategies that scale.
  • Master Storytelling & Executive Engagement:
    1. Craft and deliver C-suite-level transformation narratives that inspire confidence and action. Present Adobe’s AI-first story through compelling storytelling that integrates creativity, data, and intelligence. Be recognized as a thought leader on digital transformation and enterprise value realization.
  • Drive Industry, Partner & AI Expertise:
    1. Maintain deep understanding of assigned industries, partner ecosystems, and AI adoption trends. Leverage customer and partner insights to shape differentiated value narratives. Stay ahead of market evolution through continuous learning and engagement with Adobe’s AI and partner teams.
  • Exhibit Leadership & Enablement Excellence:
    1. Demonstrate consistent participation in the SPL Mastery Curriculum, enablement programs, and cross-functional sessions. Model accountability, preparation, and composure. Lead by example and mentor peers through field shadowing, retrospectives, and co-led pursuits.
  • Contribute to SPL Brand & Thought Leadership:
    1. Represent Adobe’s transformation leadership both internally and externally. Contribute to LinkedIn thought leadership, industry storytelling, and customer transformation showcases. Elevate Adobe’s reputation through professional visibility and partnership engagement.

Required Experience & Attributes

  • 10+ years in enterprise software, SaaS, or consulting with consistent quota attainment on $10M+ opportunities.
  • Proven ability to lead multi-year, multi-stakeholder digital transformation engagements.
  • Executive presence – credible with C-suite leaders across business, IT, and partner ecosystems.
  • Deep understanding of enterprise sales methodology, value-based selling, and outcome-based commercial structures.
  • Strong knowledge of AI trends, partner ecosystems, and consulting firm collaboration models.
  • Exceptional communication and storytelling skills – able to simplify complexity and inspire confidence.
  • Comfortable managing ambiguity, high-stakes negotiations, and accountability across cross-functional and partner teams.
  • Industry specialization or AI solution familiarity preferred (e.g., Retail, Financial Services, Healthcare, Manufacturing, Technology).

Cultural Anchors

Think Boldly. Operate with Precision. Lead from the Front.

SPLs model accountability, presence, and composure – elevating those around them and redefining what transformation selling looks like at Adobe. They focus where it matters, move with urgency, execute with precision, and lead from the front.

Our compensation reflects the cost of labor across several U.S. geographic markets, and we pay differently based on those defined markets. The U.S. pay range for this position is $256,000 -- $422,600 annually. Pay within this range varies by work location and may also depend on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for the job location during the hiring process.

At Adobe, for sales roles starting salaries are expressed as total target compensation (TTC = base + commission), and short-term incentives are in the form of sales commission plans. Non-sales roles starting salaries are expressed as base salary and short-term incentives are in the form of the Annual Incentive Plan (AIP).

In addition, certain roles may be eligible for long-term incentives in the form of a new hire equity award.

Knowledge of programmatic ad buying is advantageous

  • Opportunity to contribute to a mission-driven company transforming the job search experience.

Objetivo de garantir exposição correta dos produtos CIMED nas lojas;

Sua abrangência considera todo sortimento da CIMED nas lojas de roteiro pré-definido pela CIMED;

Resultado esperado de crescer Sell out das nossas marcas em clientes da cia.

Vagas destinadas a todas as regiões do Brasil!

Execução conforme as estratégias do programa de excelência da empresa;

Reposição de produtos no ponto de venda;

Aplicação de materiais de ponto de vendas (MPDV);

Validação e atualização das etiquetas de preço;

Coleta de informações de campo, via aplicativo de visitas online;

Auditoria e montagem de pontos extras negociados;

Report de ocorrências de campo;

Apoio a eventos e ações em loja;

Treinamento de produtos aos balconistas e novos promotores;

Apoio e auxílio ao supervisor de campo e nas visitas de campo junto a diretoria.

Possuir experiência na área;

Ensino médio completo;

Habilidades na direção de veículos leves.

  • Step 2: Avaliação comportamental 2 Avaliação comportamental
  • Step 3: Termo de Transparência 3 Termo de Transparência
  • Step 5: Entrevista com o Gestor 5 Entrevista com o Gestor

Agilidade, inovação, comprometimento e colaboração: isso é ser Cimed!

Somos uma empresa 100% nacional com o sangue amarelo correndo nas veias e queremos que todos, em qualquer canto do país, tenham acesso à saúde de qualidade, afinal, para nós remédio não tem classe social. Sabemos que o sucesso não aceita preguiça e com nosso jeito fly now de ser, vivemos o nosso propósito de proporcionar saúde e bem-estar para todos os brasileiros . Com ritmo, rotina e ritual , entregamos sempre o melhor, da nossa família para todas as outras, levando gente no coração para nos tornarmos a maior e melhor farmacêutica do Brasil.

Com atuação de ponta a ponta, desde o recebimento da matéria-prima até a entrega final nas lojas e farmácias, temos um centro de desenvolvimento e pesquisa, o Instituto Claudia Marques, além de indústria de embalagens, fabricação, frota e centros de distribuição próprios. Hoje temos a maior cadeia de distribuição de medicamentos do país, chegando nos mais de 60 mil pontos de venda por meio de nossos centros de distribuição próprios no DF e em 24 dos 26 estados do Brasil.

Agro e Transformação Digital – características do agro brasileiro, desafios tecnológicos e iniciativas de inovação. Dados no Campo – fontes (sensores, drones, satélites, sistemas de gestão), tipos de dados, pré-processamento, armazenamento, pipelines de dados e qualidade. Aplicações da IA – pecuária de precisão (monitoramento, saúde, alimentação, produtividade) e integração de tecnologias (drones, IoT, decisões em tempo real). IA Generativa – usos no agro (relatórios, previsões, simulações, assistentes virtuais), modelos disponíveis, ferramentas e limitações. Mercado e Cases – startups, plataformas e resultados alcançados. Ética e Sustentabilidade – uso responsável de dados e automação, impactos ambientais, inclusão digital e desafios regulatórios, clareza na comunicação escrita e capacidade didática.

ENTREGAS PARA ESTA DEMANDA:

Analisar o conteúdo bruto e roteiros para garantir a pertinência temática e a atualidade das informações. Realizar correções de erros conceituais. Propor melhorias para o entendimento do conteúdo. Analisar a linearidade e coesão do texto, adicionando exemplos práticos para facilitar a compreensão e a contextualização. Análise e Otimização Visual (Imagens): Conferir as imagens presentes no material, verificando sua correção, adequação ao tema, público-alvo e contexto. Propor substituições de imagens, se necessário, indicando opções de bancos de imagens ou imagens autorais com boa resolução. Garantir que as imagens selecionadas ou propostas estejam em alta qualidade e resolvam visualmente as necessidades do texto. Garantia de Qualidade e Alinhamento: Validar as atividades e seus feedbacks para assegurar que simulam casos reais e incentivam a tomada de decisão. Validar materiais complementares, confirmando sua adequação ao público-alvo e sugerindo novos, se pertinente. Assegurar que o produto final esteja conforme a expectativa do cliente e do público, com linguagem e visual adequados, conforme especificações do curso. Responsabilizar-se por sinalizar e implementar os ajustes necessários para garantir a integridade e precisão do conteúdo. Conferir e recomendar bibliografia ou material complementar. Capacitação: Realizaremos um momento de alinhamento e capacitação com o validador, para garantir que ele compreenda integralmente as diretrizes pedagógicas, os objetivos do curso e os parâmetros esperados para a atualização. Validação interna da equipe (DI): Após a entrega do conteúdo validado, a DI realizará uma leitura e solicitará os ajustes necessários, assegurando a coerência pedagógica, a aderência aos objetivos de aprendizagem e a qualidade do material produzido. Ajustes e refinamento do conteúdo: Caso sejam identificadas inconsistências ou oportunidades de melhoria, o conteúdo retornará para ajustes por parte da conteudista, seguindo as orientações da DI. Finalização e conclusão da demanda: Com os ajustes finalizados e o conteúdo aprovado internamente, consideraremos a etapa de atualização concluída, encerrando a entrega conforme o escopo previsto no contrato.

Expertise nos temas mencionados acima. Desejável experiência em validação de material didático para EaD;

We’re looking for a Program Manager to lead Design Operations end-to-end—from brief to delivery. In this role, you’ll run the operating cadence for a global creative team, own the intake and prioritization process, and coordinate closely with Marketing, Sales, Product, and Design. You’ll bring structure to creative work without stifling it: clear briefs, transparent timelines, measurable KPIs, and smooth handoffs.   • Orchestrate day-to-day workflows across the design studio; balance capacity, run weekly planning, and keep the roadmap current.
  • Own the Creative board in Asana: triage requests, clarify briefs, define priorities and due dates, and track status through delivery.
  • Partner with global stakeholders (primarily U.S.) in Marketing, Growth, Sales, and Product to turn business needs into actionable creative plans and timelines.
  • Establish operating cadences—intake, kickoffs, reviews, approvals, retrospectives—and codify SLAs from brief to handoff.
  • Lead vendor operations: NDAs, onboarding, scopes, content coordination, deliverables tracking, and invoice alignment to budget.
  • Define and track KPIs for design projects (throughput, cycle time, on-time delivery, rework rate, stakeholder satisfaction); publish clear reports.
  • Build internal communication formats and knowledge repositories: weekly updates, quarterly reviews, playbooks, and templates.
  • Support formal planning and optimization: annual and quarterly plans, resource modeling, process-improvement experiments, and post-mortems.
  • Proactively surface risks, remove blockers, and drive crisp, timely communication across time zones.

Requirements

Who You Are

Must-Haves

  • 3+ years in creative operations, PMO, marketing operations, or design program management in a fast-paced environment.
  • Mastery of project management tools (Asana required) and spreadsheets (Excel/Google Sheets); able to build dashboards and status views.
  • Demonstrated success coordinating global stakeholders and vendors; excellent written and verbal communication in English.
  • Strong process design and change-management skills; can zoom from big picture to detail and back.
  • Ownership mindset: proactive, organized, and unafraid to raise flags early and drive decisions.
  • Flexibility to collaborate with U.S.-based teams and join occasional evening calls.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience in B2B SaaS or cybersecurity.
  • Familiarity with Jira, Notion/Confluence, or similar knowledge-management tools.
  • Hands-on exposure to creative/brand/design workflows; know what a good brief and review cycle looks like.

Why Join Us?

At Cyera, we care about collaboration, innovation, and agility. We take “teamwork” seriously—with our inclusive and supportive culture at the forefront—and we’re just as serious about nurturing Cyerans to grow, both personally and professionally.

Feel free to apply even if your experience doesn’t tick every box.

We’re building something special here—and we welcome Cyerans with diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences.

ABOUT HAPPY MONEY

Happy Money is a leading consumer finance company dedicated to helping people achieve their goals through responsible lending. Sitting within the Risk and Analytics team, you will own analytics and strategy changes, periodic reporting, and initiatives that enhance our funnel conversion and optimize leads.

JOB TITLE Product Lead, Slate

LOCATION Worcester

DEPARTMENT NAME Enterprise Cloud Systems

DIVISION NAME Worcester Polytechnic Institute - WPI

JOB DESCRIPTION SUMMARY

The Product Lead, Slate, is responsible for the strategic oversight and continuous improvement of the Slate CRM platform, supporting functions such as admissions, enrollment, communications, and student engagement. This role will report to the Director, Enterprise Cloud Systems. The role leads the full product lifecycle—from ideation and development to deployment and optimization—to ensure the platform aligns with institutional goals and delivers measurable value. In this capacity, the Product Lead may manage a team, including direct reports such as system administrators or analysts who support Slate. They provide leadership, coaching, and performance management to ensure the team delivers secure, scalable, and user-centered solutions. The Product Lead works closely with these team members to align technical execution with product strategy and ensure seamless delivery of enhancements and support. The role requires close collaboration with stakeholders across business and technology domains to define and communicate a clear product vision. The Product Lead plays a key role in shaping the end-to-end user experience and ensuring that Slate evolves to meet the institution’s changing needs.

JOB DESCRIPTION

Responsibilities:

  • Serve as the Product Lead for Slate, managing tenant configuration, security administration, and release planning.
  • Provide technical support and troubleshoot issues related to Slate and other enterprise cloud systems as needed.
  • Collaborate closely with the Graduate Studies team—including Recruiting & Marketing and Admissions—Summer Studies, and University Marketing to ensure system functionality aligns with strategic goals and operational needs.
  • Define and manage the Slate product roadmap, ensuring alignment with institutional goals and user needs.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality solutions, monitor performance, and manage transitions from development to production.
  • Serve as a liaison between business units and technical teams, translating requirements and resolving integration or customization challenges.
  • Coordinate with enterprise architects and data teams to ensure alignment of product and platform strategies.
  • Evaluate and prototype new Slate features and technologies to support innovation and continuous improvement.
  • Lead major system releases, ensuring new functionality meets business and technical requirements.
  • Mentor team members who support Slate operations and development.
  • Ensure the team maintains system performance, security, and compliance standards.
  • Align team activities with product goals, ensuring operational readiness for new features and updates.
  • Foster a culture of collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, information systems or related field.
  • 6+ years of relevant experience in IT, business, or higher education, with a strong understanding of end-user needs and value drivers.
  • 3+ years in progressively responsible roles across business and/or IT functions. Business-only backgrounds are acceptable if they include significant technology collaboration.
  • Proven ability to engage and influence senior stakeholders in support of strategic initiatives.
  • Experience managing technical teams or direct reports is strongly preferred.
  • Familiarity with CRM platforms (preferably Slate), design thinking principles, and modern software delivery methodologies.
  • Strong communication, time management, and stakeholder engagement skills.

Salary: $95,000 (depending on experience)

Benefits: WPI offers a comprehensive package including 4 weeks of paid time off, an additional week at the end of December, 13 paid holidays, health, dental, and vision insurance, a 9.5% retirement match after one year, disability and life insurance, tuition assistance (including full WPI tuition for dependents after 3 years), and free access to the fitness center.

This position is responsible for handling complex accrual‑based accounting tasks for multiple clients, requiring minimal direction from Controllers. Adaptability is key to thriving in this fast‑paced environment, as the role demands responsiveness to changing expectations and processes to provide exceptional value to clients.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

  • Maintain books for multiple clients on an accrual basis, often with the help of an Assistant or Accountant as needed
  • Completion of timely and accurate monthly close process and financial reporting, including class reporting, job‑costing, analysis of account categories and defining trends
  • Manage all aspects of the accounts receivable process, including unbilled revenue, deferred income, and bad debt allowances
  • Manage all aspects of the accounts payable process, including vendor bills, and online payments
  • Prepare cash management flash report
  • Responsible for properly tracking inventory and identifying unusual or unexpected results
  • Responsible for fixed asset and intangible asset management, including maintaining depreciation and amortization schedules and posting related journal entries for acquisitions and disposals

  • Record and maintain financing transactions, such as loans and investments, including proper classification of short‑term and long‑term commitments
  • Evaluate lease contracts to determine short‑term/long‑term classification
  • Calculate and prepare tax forms and payments, such as sales & use tax, property tax returns, and client‑specific business tax and franchise tax filings

  • Updating and maintaining data for established KPIs

  • Embraces various technologies and applications to make process improvement recommendations
  • Be a proactive change‑agent; take the lead in identifying cumbersome processes and explore options of applying new technology to increase job efficiency and effectiveness
  • Lead client meetings and provide a high‑level of customer service
  • Partner with client third‑party advisors for exchange of data and reports
  • Tracks time on client engagements and manages work to meet deadlines within established time budgets; able to explain budget variances
  • Assists on special projects and additional responsibilities as needed
  • Pursues opportunities for continuous learning

Essential Skills & Experience

  • 5+ years performing full‑charge bookkeeping and 2+ years using QuickBooks and/or NetSuite Software, including daily transaction processing, monthly close and financial reporting
  • Advanced knowledge of fundamental bookkeeping and accounting principles, practices and procedures, including enhanced levels of: financial reporting and analysis, budgeting, prepaids/accruals, capitalization, financing, job costing and regulatory tax requirements
  • Possess a very high degree of accuracy and attention to detail
  • Self‑directed, highly motivated and proactive
  • Highly organized and process‑driven
  • Excellent problem‑solving, critical thinking and analytical skills
  • Proven experience meeting deadlines
  • Comfortable delegating tasks and providing feedback
  • Friendly, outgoing personality with a positive attitude and strong customer service skills who enjoys meeting and interacting with clients and staff
  • Displays excellent communication, collaboration, and problem‑solving skills
  • Comfortable interacting with clients via phone and webcam
  • Demonstrate ability to succeed in a fast‑paced environment
  • Innovative thinker and embraces change
  • Able to work independently and as a team player

  • Overseeing the maintenance and integrity of pharmacovigilance databases, ensuring accurate documentation and compliance with data management standards.
  • Providing training and mentorship to junior team members on pharmacovigilance processes, regulatory requirements, and best practices.
  • Engaging in audits and inspections conducted by regulatory authorities, ensuring readiness and compliance with all relevant pharmacovigilance requirements.

You’ll work on projects over sprints, and detail your work in tools like Jira (you’re experienced with agile methods and sprints).

  • 7+ years in SaaS systems administration: Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite.
  • Ability to create automations using bash, zsh, python, etc.
  • Ability to utilise open‑source tools such as Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki, etc.
  • Do you integrate SSO into Okta, create workflows in Okta.
  • You know how to work with APIs, and integrate one system to another.
  • You’ve provided remote support to people in multiple countries, across time zones, and you’re familiar with shipping and receiving hardware and customs.
  • Unusually great communication skills across all media — you can make your ideas clear, and you can help people who might be frustrated or time‑poor without losing your cool.

  • A desire to provide a magical experience for others — when they win, you win.
  • You take security seriously, and you know what PGP is.
  • You understand networking fundamentals and basic troubleshooting — TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing and switching.

  • You can self‑manage, and can accurately scope your project, priorities, and work across multiple teams.
  • Strong organisational and task‑management skills are critical.
  • You’re comfortable dealing with ambiguity, and sometimes making the right decision without all the data.

Nice to Haves

  • Some familiarity with AWS (you will not need certifications, but you will have used these environments a bit.)
  • You’ve used tools like GAM and command‑line interfaces to do lots of work with less effort.
  • Jamf certifications, Okta certifications, Google Workspace certifications.

Culture Fit

We’re looking for more than just operational excellence — we want a leader who thrives in the startup or tech environment and embodies our values.
The ideal candidate will:
• Have a passion for progress by being adaptable and resilient, and is comfortable navigating ambiguity in a high‑growth, fast‑paced environment.
• Have a builder’s mindset, excited to create, iterate, and scale IT practices.
• Be a collaborative partner, able to influence across functions and cultures with empathy and clarity.
• Demonstrate integrity and accountability, especially in managing confidential information across diverse legal and cultural contexts.
• Have worked in a remote environment before.

As one of the world’s leading digital asset companies, we provide tremendous growth opportunities. A comprehensive, best‑in‑class total rewards package that starts on your first day!
We offer a competitive PTO package that ensures you have the time off you deserve. Ownership in the company.

A career that provides you with purpose in your job. We remove barriers so you love what you do.

We are an equal opportunity employment organization and pride ourselves on inclusivity, diversity, and the success that comes from diversity.

Our Ledn team is truly global in nature with our people spanning across North America, Latin America, South Africa and Europe.

Senior Compensation Manager, Incentive Compensation

Position Overview

Parsons is seeking a Senior Compensation Manager, Incentive Compensation to take end-to-end ownership of our cash incentive programs, stock incentive plans, and overall equity administration—including the Employee Stock Purchase Program (ESPP). This role also serves as the primary point of contact for incentive compensation audit requests directed to the Compensation Team.

The ideal candidate is a motivated professional with a strong background in administering cash incentive programs, Proxy CD&A compensation and pay versus performance tables. This position requires a self-directed, ambitious individual who thrives in a dynamic environment and collaborates effectively across cross-functional teams to achieve organizational goals. The role offers a mix of recurring responsibilities and initiative-driven projects.

As part of a high-performing team of human resources professionals, you will lead through influence, collaboration, and expertise. Reporting to the Director of Compensation, this role is fully remote/virtual.

Key Responsibilities

  • Incentive Program Ownership
    • Manage the full lifecycle of cash-based incentive programs (STI and deferral) and stock-based incentive programs (LTI and ESPP).
    • Actively lead and mentor a team of two compensation professionals.
    • Collaborate cross-functionally to drive alignment, consistency, and excellence in program delivery.
    • Provide technical expertise to identify, assess, and execute ongoing program and process improvements.
  • Communication & Reporting
    • Develop and implement comprehensive communication plans to ensure leaders are aligned and equipped to engage program participants effectively.
    • Create accurate tracking, reporting, and forecasting solutions for all incentive programs.
    • Conduct regular audits and validations with key stakeholders to ensure program accuracy and compliance.
  • Collaboration & Issue Resolution
    • Partner with finance and payroll teams to ensure accurate and timely forecasting, reporting, and payments.
    • Address and resolve escalated participant questions or issues related to incentive plans promptly and accurately.
  • Technical Oversight
    • Partner with HRIT to translate business and operational needs into system requirements (Workday), oversee user acceptance testing (UAT), and ensure leadership alignment on decisions and recommendations.
  • Additional Contributions
    • Serve as a key contributor to Parsons’ Proxy Compensation & Discussion Analysis compensation and pay versus performance tables, and various Committee / Board materials.
    • Respond to and manage audit requests from internal and external stakeholders, ensuring proper delegation within the Compensation Team.
    • Lead or provide consultation on incentive compensation-related project initiatives.

Qualifications & Skills

  • Education
    • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Accounting, Statistics, Human Resources, or a related field.
  • Experience
    • 10+ years of related experience in incentive compensation, including some experience managing a team.
    • Industry experience in defense, intelligence, or critical infrastructure is preferred.
  • Technical & Analytical Skills
    • Strong analytical capabilities with the ability to understand broader concepts and communicate persuasively with HR and business leaders.
    • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, particularly Excel and PowerPoint.
    • Preferred experience with Workday.
  • Interpersonal & Leadership Skills
    • Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to tailor messaging to different audiences.
    • Proven ability to build and leverage relationships across an organization.
    • Strong professionalism, personal accountability, and resilience, with the ability to work effectively under pressure in a demanding environment.
    • Demonstrated integrity, objectivity, and the ability to influence at all organizational levels.
  • Certifications
    • Certified Compensation Professional (CCP) designation preferred, or progress toward CCP certification.

None

We are building a differentiated brand in a brutally competitive AI/SaaS market. This is not a “make it pretty” gig. We want a designer with exceptional taste, strong opinions, and the instincts to ship visuals that move metrics.

  • Asset turnaround under 48 h for priority requests; weekly creative batch drops.

Who You Are

  • 6+ years hands‑on design experience in SaaS/AI (agency or in‑house).

  • Fast‑paced, passionate, easy to work with. Low‑ego collaborator who communicates crisply.

Bonus Points

  • 2–4+ years in marketing/advertising environments (performance creative, concepting, storytelling).
  • Production of quick micro‑motion (feature reveals, UI walkthroughs, ad loops).

  • Experience building componentized design systems for marketing.

What We Offer

  • Start part‑time freelance; earn full‑time seat in = 12 months through results.

Portfolio with 6–10 pieces relevant to SaaS/AI marketing (ads, LPs, campaign sets, brand work). For 3 highlights, add 2–3 lines on goal, your role, outcome (metrics if possible). Short note on brands you admire in AI/SaaS and why (2–3 bullets). Optional: a 30–60s Loom walking through one project.
